nodes.label: Methodology versioning (methodology_code per profile)
nodes.rationale: Methodology changes need a version bump; storing level text per version stops old profiles being silently reinterpreted (F12).

nodes.label: Q7: In-group scored as recorded; rule in v0.3
nodes.norm_label: q7: in-group scored as recorded; rule in v0.3

nodes.label: In-group credit rule
nodes.rationale: Group-owned company making the brand's own design counts in-group; a group supplier's own calibre stays external.

nodes.label: Internal means internal (external artisan work does not raise CF/DH)
nodes.norm_label: internal means internal (external artisan work does not raise cf/dh)

nodes.label: FALK Profile (seven dimensions, never summed)
nodes.rationale: Provenance, not prestige: dimensions are scored 0-5 or U and never aggregated so the index cannot become a ranking.

nodes.label: U is not zero (U stored as NULL)
nodes.norm_label: u is not zero (u stored as null)
nodes.rationale: No U appeared in 56 records despite the rule; keeping NULL distinct from 0 in schema and UI prevents unknowns being scored as absence (F5).

nodes.label: Blued-steel level ramp (single hue)
nodes.rationale: Green-to-red rejected because it implies 5 is good; darker means more internal, not better.

nodes.label: Ruby = action colour
nodes.rationale: Jewels sit where motion happens, so ruby marks only what can be acted on: links, focus, active filter, primary button.

nodes.label: Technical hatching for U (unknown)
nodes.rationale: Section hatching marks 'no evidence'; U must look different from 0 and keep 3:1 non-text contrast.

nodes.label: Provenance, not prestige
nodes.rationale: Design must never make a profile look like a score, rank or quality verdict; outsourcing to a specialist is not inferior.

nodes.label: Rhodium, blued steel, one jewel aesthetic
nodes.norm_label: rhodium, blued steel, one jewel aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Visual language from the inside of a watch movement, not luxury advertising; depth from tonal steps between plate and bridge, never shadows.

nodes.label: Brand screen (§5.5)
nodes.rationale: Collects records but never summarizes into a brand verdict; no averaging.

nodes.label: Classification label
nodes.rationale: No pill or badge because it is a description, not a tier.

nodes.label: Send a correction form (§5.8)
nodes.rationale: Invites argument with evidence only; corrections without sources cannot be reviewed; no paid changes.

nodes.label: Gilt = provisional or disputed
nodes.rationale: Older gilt movements are the archive; gilt means not yet settled (seed records, disputed claims).

nodes.label: Watch record screen (§5.3)
nodes.rationale: Provenance sheet: profile first, classification after, every measure openable to its evidence.

nodes.label: Q12: On-site accounts; anyone can edit
nodes.norm_label: q12: on-site accounts; anyone can edit

nodes.label: Q14: PostgreSQL replaces data/ YAML as source of truth
nodes.norm_label: q14: postgresql replaces data/ yaml as source of truth

nodes.label: Publish a new version (db:publish, second reviewer)
nodes.norm_label: publish a new version (db:publish, second reviewer)

nodes.label: Server-backed architecture (Astro Node adapter, request-scoped repositories)
nodes.norm_label: server-backed architecture (astro node adapter, request-scoped repositories)
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL authoritative after verified import; fail explicitly on DB failure rather than silently serving stale YAML.

nodes.label: Git-backed content database plus static site
nodes.norm_label: git-backed content database plus static site
nodes.rationale: Git provides audit trail, authorship, diffs and PR review for free; avoids building auth, roles, audit log and backups. Ceiling: non-technical editors or high-volume community edits.

nodes.label: Profile strip (ProfileStrip.astro)
nodes.rationale: The one bold thing: seven separate side-by-side gauges with no connecting shape; real semantic tables for screen readers.

nodes.label: Records index screen (§5.2)
nodes.rationale: No sort by any score; filter by dimension range returns a set, not a ranking; filter state in URL for citation.

nodes.label: Self-hosted variable fonts
nodes.rationale: Static site avoids third-party requests; preload Archivo only since it is above the fold.

nodes.label: Seven dimensions (MA MM EX DH CF WE PD)
nodes.norm_label: seven dimensions (ma mm ex dh cf we pd)

nodes.label: Typography: Archivo + Source Serif 4
nodes.rationale: Archivo condensed widths resemble dial and drawing lettering with tabular figures; Source Serif reads like a careful report for evidence prose. Monospace rejected as template tell.

nodes.label: No sums / no total invariant
nodes.rationale: Radar charts rejected because enclosed area reads as a total; no total/average rows, no total CSV column, no sort by score.

nodes.label: Record splits 2026-10-14 (model first)
nodes.rationale: Applied 'model first' to records that mixed production routes, e.g. Shapiro Infinity vs Infinity Radiant.

nodes.label: Classification comes last
nodes.rationale: If profile and label disagree, change the label, not the profile.

nodes.label: Controlled classification vocabulary (9 archetypes)
nodes.rationale: The dataset drifted to 31 free-text labels; a controlled vocabulary plus structured modifiers (ownership, scale, IW, network) stops drift (F1).

nodes.label: Drop prestige term 'Haute'
nodes.rationale: 'Integrated Haute Manufacture' conflicts with provenance-not-prestige (F2).

nodes.label: Independent Watchmaker boolean descriptor
nodes.rationale: Separating IW from the archetype resolves inconsistent labels such as Shapiro Resurgence vs Roger W. Smith (F3).

nodes.label: Seed records shown as Provisional (is_seed)
nodes.rationale: Seed data lacks a row-level public trail, so it is labelled provisional until claims are attached (F6).

nodes.rationale: Assigned after profile and provenance review; not status tiers; ownership and scale are separate metadata. Includes Contract/Microbrand, Design-led and Artisan Etablisseur, Artisan and Watchmaking Atelier, Independent/Integrated/Industrial Manufacture, Independent Watchmaker.

nodes.label: Provenance fields

nodes.label: 56-record reference dataset

nodes.label: How to use the FALK Index (7 steps)
nodes.norm_label: how to use the falk index (7 steps)

nodes.label: Corrections workflow
nodes.rationale: No account needed; accepted correction creates a new attributed profile version and never silently rewrites the published record.

nodes.label: FALK Profile (seven dimensions, 0-5 or U)
nodes.rationale: Scores are never added together; each links to claims, sources and editorial rationale.

nodes.label: Licence: code MIT, data CC BY-SA 4.0
nodes.norm_label: licence: code mit, data cc by-sa 4.0

nodes.label: db:setup / db:import / db:export
nodes.rationale: Setup is development-only; import is idempotent and refuses to overwrite live data; export keeps git in step with live edits. data/ is seed, not runtime fallback.

nodes.label: Editor review queue (/editor/review, falk_submission, falk_review_event)
nodes.rationale: Each decision needs a note and is appended to the audit log; editors cannot review own submissions or disclosed-organization records; accepting does not change the public record.

nodes.label: Forum on FORUM_HOST (forum.falkindex.com)
nodes.rationale: Forum is its own site (ForumLayout, forum.css) on the same deployment; API, Clerk proxy, sign-in and static files shared.

nodes.label: Forum spam controls (NEW_MEMBER limits, Clerk bot protection)
nodes.norm_label: forum spam controls (new_member limits, clerk bot protection)

nodes.label: PR checklist (one watch per PR, validate, no AI excerpts, editor: ai-draft)
nodes.norm_label: pr checklist (one watch per pr, validate, no ai excerpts, editor: ai-draft)
nodes.rationale: Excerpts must be copied from live pages, not AI-written; AI-drafted claims keep editor: ai-draft.

nodes.label: Movement photograph credits (Wikimedia Commons)
nodes.rationale: Cropped/resized only; CC BY-SA adaptations shared alike; no photo stands in for a watch it is not.

nodes.label: FALK Index (README)
nodes.rationale: An evidence-led reference for how watches are actually made; a darker profile means more work inside the brand, not a quality score or ranking.

nodes.label: Archivo font, SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.norm_label: archivo font, sil open font license 1.1
nodes.rationale: Font used for server-rendered share images; may be bundled with software but not sold by itself.

nodes.label: FALK Index v0.2 Methodology Handbook
nodes.rationale: Replaces four-letter prototype with descriptive dimensions and removes the aggregate score; developed in part with AI assistance; provenance over prestige.

nodes.label: Open, community-regulated database principles
nodes.rationale: Canonical model pages, dimension-level evidence, facts separate from judgments, source hierarchy, visible disputes, version control, open corrections, commercial independence.

nodes.label: Foundational rules
nodes.rationale: Unknown is not zero; no double counting; internal means internal; authorship is not manufacture; group capability disclosed; marketing terms are claims; time matters; classification comes last.

nodes.label: Model first (exact reference as unit)
nodes.rationale: Brands use different production routes across catalogue/history; brand pages summarize but never overwrite model records.

nodes.label: Provenance, not prestige
nodes.rationale: Outsourcing to a world-class specialist is not inferior; vertical integration is not quality. Industry labels (independent, manufacture, microbrand) conflate different questions.

nodes.label: Catalogue cache (CATALOGUE_TTL_MS, last good copy)
nodes.rationale: Catalogue rebuilt from relational data and validated, shared up to 5 minutes; if a reload fails the last good copy is served.

nodes.label: Content Security Policy (report-only, CSP_ENFORCE)
nodes.rationale: Report-only until csp.violation logs are clean across sign-in, account, review, admin and forum; inline scripts hashed at build time via inline-scripts.mjs.

nodes.label: Page/image rate limits (PAGE_RATE_LIMIT log|enforce|off)
nodes.rationale: Default 'log' never blocks; API budgets in memory per instance; hourly caps on corrections/threads/posts stored in the DB.

nodes.label: Site host allowlist (SITE_HOSTS, TRUST_FORWARDED_HOST)
nodes.rationale: Unknown hosts are served as the canonical host; dev with no SITE_HOSTS accepts any host.

nodes.label: Bootstrap admin (FALK_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL)
nodes.rationale: Only the configured verified identity gets a one-time grant; first sign-up is not auto-admin; reruns do not restore revoked roles.

nodes.label: Independent FALK accounts via Replit-managed Clerk
nodes.norm_label: independent falk accounts via replit-managed clerk
nodes.rationale: Owner explicitly chose independent accounts over Sign in with Replit; public browsing never requires login.

nodes.label: Publish: Autoscale Node server
nodes.rationale: Publish copies schema from dev DB, so migrations must exist in dev first; never run unconditional import/migration at startup; forum images in Object Storage because Autoscale disks do not last.
